## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed internals with concentrated leadership (Leadership: Concentrated — 3/5 Technology in Top 5) and major divergence among large caps (NVDA, MSFT, META showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength → CORRECTION), supporting a cautious stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.96% | 1M: +112.98%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.37% | 1M: +48.37%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +29.48%). Energy follows: MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.00% | 1M: +7.92%). Consumer Staples showing steady support: WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +3.15%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication, Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare lag this week: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -28.07%), LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -3.78%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -14.26%). Industrials and Financials are mixed-to-weak on the week.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.96% | 1M: +112.98%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.37% | 1M: +48.37%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +6.67%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.00% | 1M: +7.92%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.68% | 1M: +27.80%). Leadership concentrated in Technology (3/5 Tech).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: F CORRECTION (1W: -5.73% | 1M: +0.69%), LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -3.78%), PYPL CORRECTION (1W: -6.35% | 1M: +2.22%), FDX CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +1.09%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -14.26%). Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary and select Financials/Healthcare.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +27.96%), QCOM (1W: +24.37%), ORCL (1W: +11.68%). Note MAJOR divergence: MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -4.16% | 1M: +10.33%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +10.62%), META CORRECTION (1W: -9.89% | 1M: +5.57%) — tactical volatility, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive; several names ABOVE TREND (GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +29.48%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.98% | 1M: +9.78%)) while mega-caps NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +10.62%) and MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -4.16% | 1M: +10.33%) show short-term pullbacks. Technology: 1W: +4.44% | 1M: +18.11% (24 stocks); internal rotation and concentrated leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak on the week: JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +4.72%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +6.16%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.08% | 1M: -0.71%). Financials: 1W: -0.09% | 1M: +4.52% (20 stocks) — selective exposure to names showing above-trend continuation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Tilted lower this week with pockets of strength: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +6.67%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -0.79% | 1M: +29.33%), JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -6.40%). Healthcare: 1W: -0.63% | 1M: -2.14% (17 stocks) — defensive names mixed, watch earnings/FDA catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Technology and Energy winners (QCOM, INTC, ORCL, MPC) while reducing exposure to names showing short-term CORRECTION (NVDA, MSFT, META) and structurally weak Consumer Discretionary (LOW, SHOP). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given concentrated tech top-performers and broad divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.37% | 1M: +48.37%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.96% | 1M: +112.98%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +61.35%). BEARISH: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +10.62%), META CORRECTION (1W: -9.89% | 1M: +5.57%), SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -11.81% | 1M: -9.40%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +4.44% | 1M: +18.11%) and Energy (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +0.89%) for momentum and earnings-linked moves. BEARISH: Communication and Consumer Discretionary showing stress this week; Healthcare also vulnerable (Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 900 resistance (CORRECTION test), AAPL 180–190 support zone (ABOVE TREND base), GOOGL  a break above recent highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation (ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +29.48%)), JPM 200 level as a watchpoint for follow-through (CORRECTION (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +4.72%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMD (+85): Q1/guide beat; price confirming (AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +61.35%)). QCOM (+85): hyperscaler AI win + buyback; price confirming (QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.37% | 1M: +48.37%)). ABT (+80): FDA clearance; divergence — price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -14.26%) despite very bullish headlines.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CHTR (-55): customer losses headline confirming weakness (CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -28.07%)). LOW (-45): downgrade/headline confirming (LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -3.78%)). SHOP (-45): slowing growth headline confirming weakness (SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -11.81% | 1M: -9.40%)). TSLA (-50): regulatory headwind but price diverging (TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +10.36%)) — monitor for sentiment follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.37% | 1M: +48.37%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.96% | 1M: +112.98%) and GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +29.48%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-caps (NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +10.62%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -4.16% | 1M: +10.33%)) and sentiment/price mismatches (ABT +80 vs BELOW TREND) — watch for confirmation.
